doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Ray Brown trio with Charlie Smith
summary: After a doorbell break, Jones recalls Ray Brown's 1948 trio with left-handed drummer Charlie Smith and a photograph of them.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: And Dizzy’s Two Bass Hit in 1946 and 1947. Ray left the group in 1948 to form his own trio. That was comprised of Hank Jones and Charlie Smith on drums.
That’s right! That was with Charlie Smith the left-handed drummer. He was left-handed.
Charlie Smith… I think the one clip of Charlie Parker that exists, Charlie Smith is in it. It's on a TV show.
I have a picture somewhere of Charlie, and Ray and I. Tad Damron is in the picture I think.
Do you remember what the occasion was?
